title: Zita Rakapihwa Asati Azvarwa
intro: Fungidzira nzvimbo tsvene yakanyarara yakazara nekukumbira kwemwoyo wose mushure memakore akawanda ekumirira. Kubva kune zvisingaonekwi kunouya mhinduro ine zita risati rambopiwa, uchenjeri hunovimbisa kubva mumakore ekutanga uye hupenyu hunoratidzwa nekuzvipira, tsitsi, uye kuchena.
clues: Ndakatumidzwa zita naAllah pachake ndisati ndaberekwa, zita risati rambopiwa kune mumwe munhu pamberi pangu.
Ndakatenderwa semhinduro yekukumbirwa kwemwoyo wose nevabereki vakwegura vaifunga kuti vana vaisazobvira.
Ndakapiwa uchenjeri, kutonga, neMagwaro ndichiri mudiki.
Ndaiva nehanya nevabereki vangu uye ndainzwira vamwe tsitsi, uye ndakanga ndisingazvikudzi kana kusateerera.
Allah vakaraira rugare pandiri pazuva randakaberekwa, zuva randinofa, uye zuva randichamutswa ndiri mupenyu.
Baba vangu Zakariyya vakagamuchira mashoko akanaka pamusoro pangu kubva kuvatumwa pavakamira vachinyengetera munzvimbo tsvene (mihrab).

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
